task.ques: Find the release date for the latest "Fast & Furious" movie.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The latest released Fast & Furious movie is Fast X, which opened in U.S. theaters on May 19, 2023.
Evidence: The franchise's film table lists “Fast X” with “May 19, 2023” under “U.S. release date.” The next film, Fast Forever, is dated March 17, 2028 and is upcoming.
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious#Films
Screenshot: final.png
